title: The Committed Timelines Are 2.5x to 2.9x Too Short
subtitle: Chapters 1 to 4, duration in the chapter JSON versus the MP3 the app ships
caption: The JSON durations come from a 4.5 characters per second constant plus fixed gaps in prepare-chapters.ts. The MP3 durations were read with ffprobe. generate-audio.ts, which would rewrite the timestamps from real durations, was never run on the committed data. I did not run the app to see the drift.
source: chapter JSON durations and ffprobe on the committed MP3s
